---
name: user-hobbies-painting-interest
description: Sam is looking for a hobby, plans to try painting (session with Evan planned 16 Sep 2023), loves hiking (group hike 29 Dec 2023), journaling/creative writing, sketches occasionally, morning running (Dec 2023), tries kayaking at Lake Tahoe (14 Oct 2023), gastritis ER scare (Oct 2023), became a Weight Watchers coach (Nov 2023), does yoga, discomfort limiting movement (21 Nov 2023), low motivation/confidence about weight (17 Dec 2023), self-checkout annoyance, close family (6 Jan 2024), new meal plan/workout schedule from 10 Jan 2024, car rides in countryside (11 Jan 2024), and is working on health/weight, diet, gym exercise, a healthy cooking class, and plans weight training with a trainer
type: user
---
As of 24 May 2023, Sam (the user) has no current hobbies but plans to try painting as a way to de-stress and get creative (has not tried it yet; told Evan he'll give it a go and report back, without pressure). Sam loves hiking but hasn't hiked in ages; a hike with his dad at age ten is a special memory.

Health: at a doctor check-up in about May 2023 Sam learned his weight wasn't great, which was eye-opening. He wants to break old habits and has been seeking motivation and tips (Evan suggested finding an enjoyable fitness routine and smarter diet choices). He had a tough week around 24 May 2023.

Update 6 June 2023: Sam still drinks soda and eats candy (knows it's not ideal). Evan suggested flavored seltzer instead of soda and high-cocoa dark chocolate instead of candy; Sam agreed to try and will report back. Sam asked Evan for help getting started with exercise; Evan offered to meet up and show him basic exercises.

Update 27 July 2023: Friends mocked Sam's weight on Friday 21 July 2023, which hurt and motivated him to change. He is now actively reducing soda and candy (finds it tough but is determined); he has tried flavored seltzer before and liked it, and Evan suggested pairing it with air-popped popcorn or fruit. Sam said he would start going to the gym and exercising regularly from 28 July 2023. Sam responds well to a "progress, not perfection" framing.

Update 13 August 2023: Sam said health stuff has been challenging lately and the journey feels endless at times, but he's convinced it will be rewarding. He keeps a motivational note/quote ("Don't fear it, just take the first step") and the progress-over-perfection mindset; celebrating small wins helps him. He seems to be sleeping poorly/tired.

Update 15 August 2023: Sam had a tough week and a doctor's appointment that felt like a wake-up call to take better care of himself. He is taking a cooking class to learn healthier meals, enjoying it (made a marinated grilled dish with veggies), and offered to share recipes (e.g. an easy roasted veg recipe) with Evan. Feels a mix of concern and motivation, taking it one step at a time.

Update 19 August 2023: Sam is on a diet and living healthier, sticking with it though tough; he reports more energy and less sluggishness after eating. He shared a homemade grilled chicken and veggie stir-fry recipe with Evan. Sam would like to try skiing/winter sports but is unsure his body can handle it.

Update 27 August 2023: Sam said he started a new diet and exercise routine on Monday 21 August 2023 and it has made a huge difference; he feels great. He hasn't done a road trip in ages but loves nature and wants to hike more (finds it challenging); Evan suggested a hike together and a lake about a two-hour drive away, and Sam planned to check it out as a possible day trip.

Update 11 September 2023: Sam posted a before-and-after body photo from his diet to motivate others. Still gets occasional cravings for sugary drinks/snacks, triggered by stress, boredom, or wanting comfort. Wants to try painting as a calming hobby; asked Evan for basic supplies (Evan suggested acrylic paints, brushes, canvas/paper, palette) and they planned a painting session together for next Saturday, 16 Sep 2023.

Update 6 October 2023: Sam said he's still eating healthier. He is still learning to draw, and loves expressing himself through writing (journaling and creative writing; therapeutic, helps sort feelings). He has a new phone whose navigation app malfunctions (Evan suggested updating it).

Update 8 October 2023: At a check-up on Monday 2 Oct 2023 Sam's doctor said his weight is a serious health risk and will worsen without changes; it's hitting him hard even though he joked about it before. He is interested in starting weight lifting (Evan lifts for a year) and plans to find a trainer for good form; said he'll keep Evan posted. Responds well to encouragement and taking it slow, one step at a time.

Update 14 October 2023: Sam had a rough week, gave in and bought unhealthy snacks, felt guilty; also dealing with work stress. Evan suggested kayaking; Sam had never tried it and went kayaking with a mate at Lake Tahoe that day. Evan offered to plan a kayaking trip together.

Update 17 October 2023: Sam ended up in the ER around the weekend of 14-15 Oct 2023 with a severe stomachache, diagnosed as gastritis; it was a wake-up call to prioritize health (more nutritious diet, regular exercise). Phone problems still add stress. He wants to get into fitness and asked Evan for motivation tips (Evan: set goals like distance or push-ups, pick enjoyable exercise, find a buddy). Sam and Evan plan to go on a hike together soon (no date set).

Update 25 October 2023: Sam is keeping up his health routine but finds it tough; his family is pushing him and he feels pressured. He gets impatient wanting fast results; Evan reminded him to be patient, take it one day at a time and celebrate small wins.

Update 9 November 2023: Sam became a Weight Watchers coach in his group, a big accomplishment he is proud of; hopes it keeps him motivated and lets him help others stay committed.

Update 21 November 2023: Sam said he's dealing with discomfort that limits his movement; trying diet changes but finds it hard, and fitness goals have been hard to reach. Hasn't tried new hobbies lately. Bought a 'feel good' movie on 20 Nov 2023. Suggested he and Evan appreciate something small each day.

Update 5 December 2023: Sam attended a Weight Watchers meeting on 4 Dec 2023 and found it insightful. He says yoga has improved his flexibility and stress levels and recommended it to Evan.

Update 17 December 2023: Sam said it's been a tough stretch; he's struggling with his weight, it hurts his confidence, and he lacks motivation. He still misses hiking and agreed with Evan to plan a hike soon. Finds stepping out of his comfort zone hard; Evan encouraged trying one small new thing.

Update 26 December 2023: Sam has started enjoying morning runs, which clear his head. He sketches occasionally but hasn't made anything remarkable yet; he went to an art exhibit a few days earlier. Sounded a bit wistful about not having love in his life.

Update 31 December 2023: Sam is getting into the healthier lifestyle and took friends on a hiking trip on Friday 29 Dec 2023. Evan shared healthy snack/energy ball/cookie recipes. Sam often has trouble with store self-checkouts (a running joke).

Update 6 January 2024: Sam says his family has been his rock through everything. Had homemade lasagna that night; shared a photo of a cake from his cousin's wedding.

Update 10 January 2024: Sam made a meal plan and workout schedule, starting 10 Jan 2024, motivated by The Godfather (watched 9 Jan). Hasn't seen a doctor in a while; plans to book an appointment to ask about a balanced diet plan and low-impact exercises given his current situation. Evan suggested swimming, yoga, walking and beach sunset walks; Sam plans beach walks. Sam has a recurring dream of flying over skyscrapers.

Update 11 January 2024: Sam said health issues feel rough and his weight keeps him from fully living; he's trying to stay positive. He hasn't found a low-impact exercise he enjoys, but has been taking car rides in the countryside, which relax him (shared a photo from the previous week); plans to spend more time in nature.
files.evan-friend-watercolor-prius.md:
---
name: evan-friend-watercolor-prius
description: Facts about Evan, Sam's friend: watercolor painter, new Prius (broke down 5 Dec 2023; minor accident ~30 Dec 2023), Rockies/Jasper/Banff/Canada trips, heart scare, hospital scare Nov 2023, gym, weightlifter, health journey, married the Canadian partner (~19 Dec 2023, she is pregnant; told extended family 5 Jan 2024; honeymoon in Canada Feb 2024), son's ankle, son's bike accident (12 Dec 2023), knee injuries, lost job Oct 2023, vintage guitar, beach sunset spot, grew up on an island, considering yoga, family reunion summer 2024, painting in exhibition (Dec 2023), keeps losing keys, healthy snacks, ginger snap diet, snowshoeing and rose-bush drunk incident (Jan 2024), kayaking sunset camping trip summer 2023
type: user
---
Evan is a friend Sam chats with. Evan does watercolor painting (started a few years ago, introduced by a friend) and calls it a great stress-buster. He got a new Prius after his old one broke down. Around 11 May 2023 he hiked the Rockies with his family. Around 20 May 2023 he took his family on a road trip to Jasper (Icefields Parkway, glaciers, lakes, cozy cabin). Evan keeps fit with a fitness routine he enjoys and encourages Sam to try new things and to exercise; he asks Sam to keep him updated on painting.

Around late May 2023 (told Sam on 6 June 2023) Evan had a sudden heart palpitation health scare that was a wake-up call; he is now eating less processed food and sugary snacks (loves ginger snaps). On 6 June 2023 he offered to get together and show Sam basic exercises.

On 27 July 2023 Evan said he struggled with his health a few years ago but stuck with it; he has a gym membership, and cut sugary snacks and eats more veggies and fruit. He is reading a mystery novel (said it was "The Great Gatsby"). He is a supportive friend on Sam's health journey.

On 7 August 2023 Evan said he took a trip to Canada the previous week (about 31 Jul 2023) and met a Canadian woman he describes as incredible and who makes him feel alive. He has kids. He has been working on his health for two years, with ups and downs; family and adventurous hikes motivate him, and he uses a visual progress-tracking reminder and a symbolic item representing strength and resilience. His advice: find something (big or tiny) that motivates you; small consistent steps add up.

On 13 August 2023 Evan said he'd just returned from a vacation in Canada with his new significant other (hiking, biking, outdoors). He offered support when Sam mentioned health struggles, and tends to say to celebrate small wins. He was also hunting for lost keys that day.

On 15 August 2023 Evan said his son hurt his ankle in a soccer accident on Saturday 12 August 2023; Evan took him to the doctor, and it's improving but still sore (nothing serious). Evan wants to add more vegetables to his meals and asked Sam for recipes.

On 19 August 2023 Evan said he started watercolor painting classes a few days earlier (about mid-Aug 2023) to meet like-minded people and improve; the instructor stresses observing nature. He loves painting landscapes and enjoys road tripping in his car. He went skiing in Banff last month (about July 2023) and plans to go back next year. He enjoys skiing, snowboarding and ice skating and would like Sam to join him someday. He asked for and accepted Sam's stir-fry recipe.

On 27 August 2023 Evan said he twisted his knee on Friday 25 August 2023, which disrupted his fitness routine; he is waiting for a physical therapy appointment and swimming meanwhile. He's still enjoying the book he's reading. He mentioned a road trip to the Rocky Mountains in July 2023 and suggested hiking together with Sam, recommending a lake about two hours' drive away.

On 11 September 2023 Evan said healthier choices have made a difference for him, and that painting or going for a drive helps when stressed. He offered to help Sam get started with painting (recommended acrylic paints, brushes, canvas/paper, palette) and they planned a painting session for Saturday 16 Sep 2023.

On 6 October 2023 Evan said he hurt his knee again (~late Sep 2023) playing basketball with the kids; PT helps, he does only easy strengthening exercises and misses outdoor adventures. He keeps painting watercolors (sunset painting from a vacation years ago, cactus painting from a road trip in Sep 2023); he paints what he feels or places he wants to go, as self-expression. About 22 Sep 2023 he helped a lost tourist and ended up touring the city.

On 8 October 2023 Evan said he started lifting weights about a year ago (~Oct 2022); it was a struggle at first but he's seeing gains. He advised Sam to start small, learn good form with a trainer, stay consistent, and be patient.

On 14 October 2023 Evan said he just finished a sunset painting that helps him relax. He suggested kayaking to Sam for stress relief, offered to recommend a spot and plan a kayaking trip together.

On 17 October 2023 Evan said he's focused on fitness (was at the gym 16 Oct 2023, gaining strength) and met another lost tourist recently (recurring theme). He advised Sam to set goals, pick enjoyable exercise, and find a workout buddy, and they plan to go on a hike together soon.

On 25 October 2023 Evan said he'd just come back from a morning walk, which he likes for starting the day actively. He said about two years ago he went through a similar phase: changed his diet and started walking regularly, and found that focusing on well-being rather than quick results and letting go of pressure made a big difference. He encouraged Sam to go one day at a time and celebrate small victories.

On 9 November 2023 Evan said he lost his job in about Oct 2023 when his company downsized; he is job hunting and trying to stay hopeful, and had personal challenges lately. He got a 1968 Kustom K-200A vintage guitar as a gift from a close friend. He finds peace at a favorite beach spot near home for sunsets (photo taken Fri 3 Nov 2023). He and Sam plan to visit it together next month (Dec 2023).

On 21 November 2023 Evan said that about the week of 13 Nov 2023 he went to the hospital after something suspicious showed up in a check-up; it turned out to be a misunderstanding and doctors say he's fine, but it reminded him to value health and life. He stays fit via the gym and driving his car. He shared a photo of the small island where he grew up, his 'happy place'. He told Sam he's there if Sam needs to talk.

On 5 December 2023 Evan said his newly bought Prius broke down, which stresses him since he relies on it for his active lifestyle and road trips; he's trying to see it as a chance to find other ways to stay active and travel. He is thinking of trying yoga for stress relief and flexibility; Sam encouraged it and offered tips.

On 9 December 2023 Evan announced his partner is pregnant; they're excited (and a bit nervous), the first child in a while. He shared a family-memories collage with a 'Bring it on Home' sign from their Banff trip (family motto about togetherness). They plan a big family reunion in summer 2024. Sam offered event-organizing tips.

On 17 December 2023 Evan said his son fell off his bike on Tuesday 12 Dec 2023 and was hurt, but is doing better. Evan shared a contemporary figurative painting he finished a few days earlier; a close friend helped get it published in an exhibition. He again suggested planning a hike with Sam soon.

On 26 December 2023 Evan said he got married the previous week (~19 Dec 2023) to the Canadian woman (love at first sight, he says). He shared a painting of his made while feeling sad, mad and hopeful, and another made with joy and freedom. He offered again to help Sam start painting. He loses his keys weekly; Sam suggested a GPS tracker and Evan liked the idea.

On 31 December 2023 Evan said he took the Prius on a long mountain drive the previous weekend (~23-24 Dec 2023) and had a minor accident on the way back (everyone fine); it dampened telling his work friends about the marriage, though they're supportive. He's trying healthy snacks (energy balls, cookies) and offered to send Sam recipes.

On 6 January 2024 Evan said he and his partner told their extended family about the marriage on 5 Jan 2024; families are very supportive. He's on a new diet limiting himself to two ginger snaps a day. They plan a honeymoon in Canada in Feb 2024 (skiing, local food, trying poutine) and he'll report back to Sam.

On 10 January 2024 Evan said he drank too much with friends on 9 Jan 2024 and urinated near someone's roses; he apologized and they were understanding. He and his partner tried snowshoeing the weekend of 6-7 Jan 2024 and found it fun. He recommended swimming, yoga and walking as low-impact exercise to Sam, says yoga helps his stress and flexibility, and loves beach sunset walks.

On 11 January 2024 Evan said he apologized to his partner for the drunken night (she wasn't thrilled but understood it was an accident). He shared a photo of a sunset from a camping/kayaking trip on a lake last summer and said nature is like a reset button; reiterated he's there for Sam.
